description: If you stay in this centrally located place, you will be close to everything as a family. 1 bedroom 2 bed 1+1 luxury apartment with free parking and private security in the Taksim360 project close to Taksim Square, the heart of Istanbul. It is only 5 minutes on foot to Taksim Square and Taksim metro station. 1-minute walk to the bus stop. The apartment on the 2nd floor of the building on the site is very quiet.

reviews.text:
Amazing stay in the heart of Taksim!
We enjoyed staying in Mr Taner place , Apartments was exactly as describe and even more better..
He’s taking care of his place perfectly .
Apartment was lovely, clean and comfortably furnished , kitchen is full with everything that needs..
Location walkable distance to Istiklal Street and the metro in Taksim ! But we never felt the noise, place was quiet and security guards within 24/7
We would definitely recommend staying at this apartment and for sure will not be the last time for us…
And also a special thanks to Onur , who was incredibly helpful, friendly, and always available whenever we needed anything .

Taner is a lovely host and the apartment was as exactly describe and shown in photos. I stayed in 2 of his apartments and both were perfect. Very clean and cozy and you feel so at home. The building also has 24 hour security and has a good location with easy access to many different neighbourhoods in Istanbul . Thankyou again taner I will definitely stay again in the future 🥰

We had such a wonderful stay! The place was exceptionally clean, tidy, and well taken care of, not something you find everywhere 🤗 It really made us feel comfortable and at home throughout our stay.
The host was amazing, very attentive, kind, and always available whenever we needed anything. We truly appreciated the care and hospitality ❤️
The location was also perfect for us, very convenient and exactly what we were looking for. We would also like to mention the building guards, who were all so kind, friendly, and welcoming 🥰
Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommended! ✨

I had a wonderful stay here! Taner and Onur went over and beyond to deliver a great service. The place is well decorated, clean and worth the money. I would recommend this place for couples or adults. It’s only 5-10 minutes to walk to Taksim. Everything is as described! Thank you Taner and Onur.
Great place, great communication, and great location. Very clean. Everything as described. Recommended
